name: kiki-relay
description: Reach Kiki spaces without a public IP through self-hosted encrypted relays with end-to-end TLS pinning.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted zero-knowledge rendezvous relay for Kiki

zh-CN.shortDescription: 无公网 IP 端到端证书固定的自建中转服务

commands.name: relay-setup
commands.description: Generate self-hosted kiki-relay deployment and reverse-proxy configuration
commands.prompt: Use relay_deploy_guide and relay_status to help set up a self-hosted kiki-relay server (Docker, Node.js, and Caddy/Nginx/OpenResty/Cloudflare reverse proxy) and import its kiki-relay:// share link.

tools.name: relay_status
tools.description: Read current kiki-relay encrypted rendezvous nodes, Home/Standby latency slots, team subscriptions, and local relay server state without exposing tokens.

tools.name: relay_deploy_guide
tools.description: Generate ready-to-run Docker, docker-compose, Node.js, and reverse-proxy (Caddy, Nginx, OpenResty, Cloudflare) configuration snippets for self-hosting kiki-relay.
